test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

To take something on loan with the intention of returning it.
solution: The correct answer is '**Borrow**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Borrow**'. • It means 'to take or receive something from somebody/something that you intend to give back, usually after a short time' (उधार, कर्ज़ या ऋण लेना) • *Example: I had to **borrow** from the bank to pay for my car.* **Correct Answer:__** *Borrow.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Lease**: a legal agreement that allows you to use a building or land for a fixed period of time in return for rent. (एक क़ानूनी क़रारनामा जिसके अनुसार किसी भवन या भूखंड को निर्धारित अवधि के लिए किराए पर लिया जाता है; पट्टा, लीज़, इज़ारा) • **Lend**: to allow somebody to use something for a short time or to give somebody money that must be paid back after a certain period of time. (थोड़े समय के लिए उधार देना) • **Hire**: to have the use of something for a short time by paying for it. किसी वस्‍तु को किराए पर लेना 43:T6d6, The correct answer is '**many**'.
